structure_plan.overview: Brick-built minifig-style Jedi holding a blue lightsaber: light-bluish-gray display base, white body/robes, red belt accent, white head with simple black eyes, yellow hair cap, lightsaber with light-bluish-gray hilt and trans-clear/blue blade held diagonally in front.

subassemblies.name: B. Legs + Hips
subassemblies.description: Two white legs on base with a thin red belt/waist band.

subassemblies.name: C. Torso + Arms
subassemblies.description: White torso block with simple forward arms positioned to hold the saber.

subassemblies.name: D. Head + Hair
subassemblies.description: 2x2 head with SNOT eyes; yellow sloped hair silhouette.

subassemblies.name: E. Lightsaber
subassemblies.description: Round-stacked hilt and 1-stud-wide blade in trans-clear/blue.

step_outline.title: Build base (6x6)
step_outline.description: Assemble a 6x6 plate in LightBluishGray using 3020/3021/3022/3023/3024 as needed (keep studs up).

step_outline.title: Left foot/leg core
step_outline.description: On the back half of the base, place a 2x2 footprint for the left leg using White 3022 (plate) then stack White 3003 bricks to make the leg 3 bricks tall.

step_outline.title: Right foot/leg core
step_outline.description: Mirror step 2 for the right leg, leaving a 1-stud gap between legs if possible for minifig stance.

step_outline.title: Hips + belt line
step_outline.description: Bridge both legs with a White 3020 (2x4 plate) or equivalent across the top; add a Red 3023 (1x2 plate) on the front center as the belt accent.

step_outline.title: Torso layer 1
step_outline.description: Build a 4x2 White torso block centered over the hips using White 3001/3002/3004 bricks (2 bricks tall total torso height target: 2 bricks).

step_outline.title: Attach shoulder studs for arms
step_outline.description: On each torso side, add a LightBluishGray 87087 (studs on opposite sides) so one side stud points forward (for arm/hand attachment) and the other side stud connects into the torso side.

step_outline.title: Upper arms
step_outline.description: On each forward-pointing side stud from step 6, attach a White 3004 (1x2 brick) oriented forward as the upper arm. Keep arms symmetric and slightly forward.

step_outline.title: Hands/grips
step_outline.description: At the front end of each arm, attach a LightBluishGray 87087 oriented so one stud points inward toward the centerline (to mount the lightsaber hilt). Add a Yellow 4070 (round 1x1 brick) under/near each grip if you want a thicker ‘hand’ look (optional, inventory-permitting).

step_outline.title: Neck
step_outline.description: Place a White 3024 (1x1 plate) centered on top of the torso as a neck spacer.

step_outline.title: Head core with eye SNOT
step_outline.description: Build head base: use two White 87087 bricks side-by-side with their side studs facing forward; cap with a White 3022 (2x2 plate). Attach two Black 98138 (round 1x1 tiles) to the forward studs as eyes.

step_outline.title: Head top and shape
step_outline.description: Stack a White 3003 (2x2 brick) on the head to reach a 2-brick-tall head. Optionally add a thin White plate layer (3022) under hair for spacing.

step_outline.title: Hair silhouette
step_outline.description: Use Yellow slopes (3039/3040/2420 as available) to create a rounded hair cap: place Yellow slopes on the top and front edges of the head to suggest swept hair. Substitute with Yellow 3004/3022 if slope counts are short.

step_outline.title: Build lightsaber hilt
step_outline.description: Stack LightBluishGray round parts: 3062b (round 1x1 open stud) + 4070 (round 1x1 brick) + 3062b to form a short hilt (3 modules tall). Add a TransClear 98138 (round tile) on top as the emitter flare (optional).

step_outline.title: Build blade
step_outline.description: On top of the hilt, stack 3062b rounds alternating TransClear and Blue (e.g., TransClear + Blue + TransClear) to form a 4–5 module blade depending on remaining parts.

step_outline.title: Mount saber between hands
step_outline.description: Press the hilt onto the inward-pointing stud of one hand-grip (step 8). Secure/stabilize by lightly touching/aligning the saber against the other hand/grip (no extra clips available). Angle it diagonally upward to match the preview silhouette.

notes: Face/robes are simplified due to no printed elements; eyes use Black 98138 on forward SNOT studs.
If 2420/3039/3040 slope geometry differs, keep the hair as a 2x2 yellow cap using any available yellow slopes/plates.
Lightsaber stability relies on stud connections; shorten blade if it droops (reduce stacked 3062b rounds).
Keep figure centered over the base to prevent tipping; widen stance by spacing legs 1 stud apart if your plate layout allows.
